candidates.name: John Frankman
candidates.bio: John Frankman is a Republican candidate for Florida's 1st Congressional District. He served eight years in the U.S. Army as a captain with 7th Special Forces Group (Green Beret) and left the service on July 1, 2023. He says he was forced out over the military's COVID-19 vaccine mandate.
key_messages: Defend medical freedom, medical privacy, and the constitutional freedom to make your own healthcare decisions
Cut reckless federal spending, rein in the national debt, and vote on single-subject bills instead of omnibus packages
Fight for mass deportations and complete the border wall
Fully fund and modernize the armed forces and fix the VA, including a full-service VA hospital in Northwest Florida
Secure elections with proof of citizenship to register and vote, strong voter ID, and paper ballots

campaign_themes.heading: Medical freedom
campaign_themes.text: Protect the constitutional freedom to make their own healthcare decisions and protect medical privacy, opposing government mandates. Supports repealing liability shields such as those created by the 1986 Childhood Vaccine Injury Act, proposes a Medical Freedom Amendment, would expand Health Savings Accounts so patients, not insurance companies, control care, require full price transparency on drugs and medical procedures, and pursue Most Favored Nation status on drug prices.

campaign_themes.heading: Military and veterans
campaign_themes.text: Fully fund and modernize our armed forces and support active-duty families. Fix the VA by expanding access to care and reducing wait times, and advocate for a full-service VA hospital in Northwest Florida. Fight for service members forced out of the military by the COVID shot mandate.

campaign_themes.heading: Immigration
campaign_themes.text: Fight for mass deportations, support legislation that makes it illegal to house or employ illegals, and complete the border wall.

campaign_themes.heading: Debt and affordability
campaign_themes.text: Cut reckless federal spending and rein in our national debt. Reduce the size of the federal government, slash unnecessary agencies, and back single-subject spending bills instead of omnibus packages.

campaign_themes.heading: Energy
campaign_themes.text: Expand domestic energy production and reduce reliance on foreign adversaries, to bring down the price of gas, electricity, and groceries.

campaign_themes.heading: Government accountability
campaign_themes.text: Demand transparency and ensure elected officials answer to the people. Supports full transparency on the Epstein case and associated records, and reform of congressional conduct including taxpayer-funded settlements.

campaign_themes.heading: Election integrity
campaign_themes.text: Require proof of U.S. citizenship to register and vote, back strong voter ID laws, oppose mail-in ballot harvesting, and demand paper ballots with same-day counting where possible.

campaign_themes.heading: Infrastructure
campaign_themes.text: Fight for critical upgrades to Highway 98 and real infrastructure improvements in Northwest Florida.

campaign_themes.heading: Farmers and local industry
campaign_themes.text: Cut unnecessary regulations, protect family farms from federal intrusion, and ensure fair access to markets.

campaign_themes.heading: Abortion
campaign_themes.text: States he is 100% pro-life and will never apologize for it.

campaign_themes.heading: Second Amendment
campaign_themes.text: Oppose any federal gun control schemes and support national reciprocity for concealed carry.

campaign_themes.heading: Women's sports
campaign_themes.text: Preserve Title IX protections and ensure women's sports remain for biological women.

top_stances.summary: Protect constitutional right to medical freedom and privacy; oppose government mandates and vaccine liability shields; expand HSAs and price transparency.
top_stances.track_record_note: Left U.S. Army as captain after opposing military COVID-19 vaccine mandate; foundation of campaign's medical freedom platform.

top_stances.summary: Support mass deportations, complete border wall, legislation criminalizing employment and housing of undocumented immigrants.
